rows.projectName: PRIMARY BOYS SCHOOL AT EAST HIDD - (T/25/2026)
rows.enquiryDetails:
Construction of a complete primary school for boys at East Hidd comprising 40 classrooms, a sports hall, administration block, Science lab, Family Education, computer labs, and all associated support facilities. The project also includes comprehensive sports facilities consisting of external handball, basketball, and volleyball courts and an elevated soccer field, as well as internal handball, 
basketball, and volleyball courts.
